tool.name: org_fingerprint
tool.description:
Org-level external recon: WHOIS, ASN ownership, GitHub-org presence, and typosquat detection.
This is the "what else does this org expose" check. Wraps four bounded probes:
- **WHOIS** via the sandbox `whois` binary — registrar, creation/expiry dates, nameservers, registrant org and country, DNSSEC status. Privacy-protection markers detected. - **ASN ownership** via Team Cymru's DNS-mapped origin zone (no API key) — returns the AS number, prefix, country, registry, and allocation date for the apex IP. - **GitHub org presence** — one HEAD per likely org-name candidate (apex label, with/ without dashes, common-suffix-stripped). Up to 3 candidates probed. - **Typosquats** — ~25 candidates via homoglyph (o↔0, rn↔m), adjacent transposition, one-character deletion, neighbour-key substitution, and alt-TLD variants. Each one is DNS-resolved; resolved candidates get a HEAD probe to see if there's a live website. Any resolved typosquat emits a low-severity `info_disclosure` finding (info severity if no live site, low if there is one).
Use this during recon for any `domain` target. Output is the structured dict — WHOIS and ASN data are informational and surface only in the return value, not as findings; typosquats that resolve are emitted as findings.
Categories of check events emitted: `org_fingerprint`, `asn_ownership`, `github_org_presence`, `typosquat`.

parameter.name: domain
parameter.description: Apex domain (e.g. "example.com" — not a URL, not a subdomain).

parameter.name: skip_typosquats
parameter.description: When true, skip the typosquat candidate generation and DNS sweep. Useful for fast pre-flight runs where only WHOIS / ASN / GitHub data is needed.

returns.description:
{success, domain, whois, asn, github_candidates, typosquats_probed, typosquats_resolved, typosquat_details}.
`whois` keys: registrar, creation_date, expiry_date, registrant_organization, registrant_country, name_servers (list), dnssec, privacy_protected (when detected).
`asn` keys: ip, asn, prefix, country, registry, allocated, lookup_status.
`github_candidates`: list of {name, url, exists, status}.
`typosquat_details`: list of {candidate, resolves, has_web, notes}.
